sub: Flirty dares, daring confessions, mischief with a wink.

1.name: Warm-Up
q: Guess my most useless skill.~Then I demonstrate it, right now, badly.
Both say your 2am order on three.~Whoever's is sadder defends it with a straight face.
Open your predictive text and read the next three words it suggests. Out loud.~No editing, no pretending it said something else.
Guess a rumour about me I kind of wish were true.~Then I tell you mine, and you decide whether to start it.
Guess one thing about them right now, out loud — then find out how close you got.
Say your most confidently wrong opinion.~They get thirty seconds to change your mind. You have to actually consider it.
Pick the song that's basically your personality tonight, then play the first ten seconds.
Guess the last thing I searched that I'd rather not explain.~Then I show you. No scrolling first.
Do your go-to excuse for leaving early, right now, to my face.~I rate how convincing it was out of ten.
What's the boldest thing on your bucket list you'll actually say out loud right now?
Give yourself a compliment nobody asked for.~They cheer like you've just won something. Full commitment, no irony.
Do the face you made faking liking a bad gift.~They guess what the gift was.
Show them your go-to photo trick — angle, filter, pose, all of it.~They rate it out of ten and justify the score.
Guess which app on my phone I'd be most embarrassed for you to scroll.~One guess. Then I hand it over for ten seconds.
Tell them a completely made-up fact with total confidence.~They guess whether it's the fake one or something you actually believe.
What's the childhood nickname you're weirdly glad never followed you into adulthood?
Do your 'I'm fine, everything's fine' face right now.~They do an impression of it back. You rate the accuracy.
Guess what I'm unearnedly confident about but actually mediocre at.~Then I prove you right, immediately.
What's the one screenshot on your phone you'll never delete but would never explain?
Say the last white lie you told.~Now say it again while they cross-examine you. They get three questions.
Your type, in one word. No elaborating.~Then they guess how close they are to it. You confirm or deny.
Guess the compliment they're quietly fishing for tonight.~If you're right, give it to them properly.
What's the most grown-up purchase you've ever made that you're secretly proud of?
Guess the emoji I overuse.~Then check my phone. Loser owes a compliment.
Say a talent you'd list on a dating profile that's a total lie.~Now prove it, badly, right now.
What's the pettiest personal record you hold that nobody has ever actually asked about?
Name a word you say too often. You're banned from it for three cards.~Every slip, they get one free question.
What's a food combination you love that everyone else finds disturbing?
Reenact the most dramatic you've been about losing a game that didn't matter.~They rate the drama out of ten.
Sing four seconds of your actual karaoke song.~They decide whether you've earned the mic.
What's a fashion phase you thought was iconic at the time that you'd never repeat now?
What's the smallest, pettiest inconvenience that's ever completely ruined your mood?
Do your go-to move for when small talk runs out — on them, right now.~They tell you honestly whether it worked.
What's the last thing you privately celebrated like you'd just won an Olympic medal?
What's a rule you have for yourself that would make zero sense to anyone else?
What's an unnecessarily specific opinion you have about the 'right' way to do something completely ordinary?
Record your voicemail greeting out loud, in the voice.~If they say it's good, you have to actually keep it.
What's the most mortifying name you've ever given a playlist?
What's a childhood fear that, if you're honest, never fully went away?
Do your 'just won something' walk across the room. Three steps, full commitment.~They score it out of ten. No mercy.
What's your go-to party order — drink or snack — and what does it actually say about you?
What's the weirdest thing you've looked up about someone before you'd even met them?
Guess my tell for when I'm bored but too polite to say so.~Then I tell you whether you've seen it tonight.
What's a habit from a past version of you that you're quietly glad nobody filmed?

2.name: Cheeky
q: Rate your own flirting, smooth to disaster, and defend the score.~Then they give you their number for you. You have to accept it.
Say the smoothest thing you've ever said — in the voice you said it in.~They rate whether it would have landed on them.
Guess their tell for when they actually like someone.~Then they say whether you've seen it tonight.
Confess the most obvious signal you completely missed.~They guess how long it took you. Closest to the truth wins.
Act out the most chaotic thing you've done for someone's attention.~They decide whether it deserved to work.
What's the pettiest thing you've ever been genuinely smug about?
What's the most ridiculous reason you've ever been annoyed at someone you actually liked?
Read out a text you've drafted and never sent. Word for word.~They decide whether you should send it. You don't have to obey.
What's the most outrageous thing you've ever done for a discount, an upgrade, or a free anything?
Say the hot take that's cost you a friend.~They argue the other side for thirty seconds. Neither of you backs down.
What's the cheapest thing you've ever done that you'd 100% do again, no shame?
Use your boldest opening line on them right now, like you've never met.~They tell you honestly whether it lands.
Sixty seconds of completely fake confidence about anything in this room. Go.~They rate how convincing you were.
What's a rule you break specifically because you know you'll get away with it?
Demonstrate your recovery move for saying something awkward.~They set you up with something awkward first.
Guess what they're secretly keeping score about.~Then they admit theirs, and you admit yours.
Sell them a genuinely terrible idea for thirty seconds.~They say the exact point they nearly bought it.
What favour have you asked for that you had absolutely no right to ask for — and got anyway?
Name a compliment you'd never fish for but would absolutely take.~They give it to you now, and you just take it.
Say a lie you've told so often you half believe it.~They decide whether you still believe it. No arguing.
What's the most unbothered you've ever pretended to be while internally losing it?
Read out the boldest text you've ever sent, unprompted.~They rate the audacity out of ten.
What's a skill you oversold in an interview, on a date, or both?
What's the most chaos you've ever caused purely to make someone laugh at exactly the right moment?
Guess the last compliment that got to me even though I played it cool.~Then I tell you. Then you try to beat it.
What's the most main-character outfit you've ever fully committed to?
Deploy your secret impress-people talent right now.~They rate whether they're impressed. Honestly.
What's the boldest thing you've ever done specifically to make someone jealous?
Do the most obvious move you've made to signal you liked someone, without words.~They guess what it was meant to mean.
Guess the little game they play to make someone chase them.~Then they confirm, and say whether they've played it tonight.
What's the most shameless thing you've said to keep a conversation going five minutes past its natural end?
What's the boldest 'so, are you free later?' you've ever actually said out loud?
Give them a compliment that's really just flirting in disguise.~They have to call which one it is.
On three, both name the tiniest thing that makes you instantly more interested.~If either of you has done the other's tonight, say so.
What's the most competitive you've ever gotten over something that was supposed to be completely casual?
Guess the nickname I've given you in my head. Two guesses.~Then I tell you, and you're stuck with it.
What's the most shameless thing you've done to stretch a night out that was supposed to end early?
Do your most transparent 'playing hard to get' move on them right now.~They rate how transparent it is, out of ten.
Tease them about something. Right now, properly.~They get one comeback. Best line wins — they judge.
What's a flirty text you sent, then reread out of pure pride, more than once?
What's the sneakiest thing you've ever done to end up sitting next to someone on purpose?
What's the boldest move you've made to win someone back over after a genuinely awkward first impression?
Fake-complain about something so they'll compliment you.~They decide whether to give it to you. They probably won't.
What's the boldest compliment you've ever given a total stranger, completely out of nowhere?
Get caught staring at them on purpose, then do your best recovery.~They rate the recovery out of ten.

3.name: Bold
q: Say the cockiest thing you genuinely believe about yourself. Dead serious, no smiling.~They aren't allowed to laugh for ten seconds.
Guess the boldest lie I've got away with as an adult.~Then I tell you, and you say whether you'd have fallen for it.
Growing up, what's the boldest lie you told that your parents still, to this day, have no idea about?
Reenact the most main-character thing you've done in public.~They score it out of ten for commitment.
Guess the rumour I'd love someone to start about me.~Then I tell you, and you decide whether to start it.
Say your most unhinged theory about them — kind enough to say to their face.~They rate how close you got.
What's the cheekiest thing you ever got away with at school or work, zero regrets?
What's something you'd tell a total stranger before you'd tell your best friend — and why do you think that is?
Say the most arrogant sentence you can about yourself. Dead serious, no cracking.~They have to agree with it out loud, whether they mean it or not.
What's the boldest thing you've ever talked your way into that you absolutely did not deserve?
Write the true tabloid headline about yourself tonight. Say it in a newsreader voice.~They write the correction.
What's the most shameless thing you've done to get someone's number — and did it actually work?
What's the boldest yes you've ever said with zero explanation attached?
Guess the audacious rumour I'd never bother correcting.~Then I tell you, and you say whether you'd believed it.
What's the cockiest text you've ever sent, and did your confidence survive the reply?
Start a 'so, funny story…' about something nobody here knows. You don't have to finish it.~They decide whether to make you finish. You can still refuse.
What's the most 'I can't believe I actually said that' sentence that's ever come out of your mouth?
Name a reputation you've got that's completely undeserved.~They say whether they'd have guessed it about you tonight.
Guess the boldest thing I've done purely to win with nothing on the line.~Then I tell you, and you say whether it was worth it.
What's the most audacious thing you've ever said to talk your way out of trouble?
Confess the moment you were the most shameless version of yourself — would you do it again?
Demonstrate the confidence move you save for when it really matters.~They tell you whether it would work on them.
Say the line you've been dying to use on them all night. Full commitment.~They rate it, and they have to be honest.
Say the boldest compliment about yourself that you secretly agree with.~They say it back as though they thought of it first.
Guess the most trouble I've caused on purpose just because I could.~Then I tell you, and you say whether you'd have joined in.
What's the wildest thing you've ever talked someone else into doing on a dare?
On three, both say the legend you'd want told about tonight.~Different legends? Argue for yours.
What's the boldest excuse you've ever used to bail on something you'd already fully committed to — and did anyone ever find out?
Name the secret you're one drink away from telling this room.~You don't have to tell it. Just rate how big it is, out of ten.
Guess the most scandalous thing about them that'd surprise people.~Then they tell you, and you don't get to look shocked.
What's the most shameless thing you've ever done to make someone who doubted you watch you thrive?
Say the wildest thing you've said to a stranger — to them, now, in the same tone.~They react exactly as the stranger did.
What's the boldest dare you've ever accepted without a single second of hesitation?
Tell a version of the truth that's technically accurate and completely misleading.~They have to spot which part was doing the work.
Confess the most reckless thing you've ever done purely because someone told you that you couldn't.
Reenact the face you made proving someone wrong.~They guess what you'd just proved.
Confess the most confidently incorrect thing you've ever corrected someone on, in front of a crowd.
What's the closest you've ever come to being thrown out of somewhere — and would you do it again?
Say the boldest 'no' you've ever given — the one that cost you.~They ask what it cost. You answer straight.
What's the wildest thing you've ever done to avoid admitting you were wrong?
Act out the most shameless thing you've done to skip a queue.~They decide whether they'd have let you.
What's the wildest promise you've ever made in the heat of the moment and somehow actually kept?
What's the most shameless victory lap you've ever taken for something you barely did any work for?
Guess the pettiest thing I've done to steal someone's spotlight.~Then I tell you, and you rate the pettiness out of ten.

wild: Give a ten-second sales pitch for the most useless object within reach — full enthusiasm, no breaking character.
Do your best impression of the last person you texted. They guess who it is.
Swap phones for fifteen seconds. Change one thing on their home screen before you swap back.
Give them a nickname on the spot — it's in effect for the rest of the night, no appeals.
Confess one small lie you've told tonight, right now — then say what actually happened.
Guess their most-used emoji, then check their phone to see if you're right.
Say the single most confident, over-the-top thing you can about yourself. They have to cheer like you just won something.
Pick an accent. You're stuck in it for the next three cards — they call it the second you slip.
Text a friend — not an ex, not your boss — the exact emoji combo they pick for you, zero context. Read the reply out loud the moment it lands.
Give a fully confident, quietly ridiculous fifteen-second alibi for something you obviously did. Zero evidence, total conviction.
Give them full control of your music for the next thirty seconds — whatever they play, you vibe to it, no complaints.
Design their entrance for the next time they walk into a room. They have to demo it immediately, full commitment.
Give a fifteen-second toast for them, right now — half compliment, half loving roast.
Give a dead-serious, five-star product review of the person across from you — full corporate-review voice. They read it back out loud when you're done.
Order an imaginary coffee like it's the final scene of a telenovela — full drama, no words. They guess what you ordered.
Predict, in one sentence, exactly where they'll be in five years. Say it like you're already certain.
Do a dramatic slow-motion reaction to the best news you've had all year — and freeze on the final frame for three full seconds.
Hold a dead straight face for thirty seconds while they try absolutely anything — short of touching you — to break it.
Narrate the next sixty seconds of this game like a hushed nature documentary.
Pick a prop within reach, turn it into a microphone, and deliver a ten-second acceptance speech for 'Best Person In This Room.'
Give them a made-up superhero name and power, based on nothing but vibes — zero thinking time allowed.
Do your best exaggerated, affectionate impression of the person across from you. They rate the accuracy out of ten.
Deliver one devastating one-liner like you're in the trailer for the movie of your life.
Whisper the plot of your favourite movie in fifteen seconds flat — they guess the title before time's up.
final: Before you say anything — look at them. Actually look, for a second longer than feels normal.
Now say the nicest true thing you've got left. No joke to hide behind yet.
There — you've earned the joke back. Ruin the moment properly, then go be trouble together.
